title: PostgreSQL service fails during startup
root_cause: The failed run and the successful baseline use the same commit, so no repository change in the comparison caused the failure. PostgreSQL could not bind its network address or create a TCP/IP socket, so the service did not become healthy and the integration test never started. The service's network binding must be restored.

relevant_evidence.why: The service is unhealthy and PostgreSQL reports that it cannot bind its address or create TCP/IP sockets.
